subject: Scaling to new business units: key segmentation & SLA amendment
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Rosario <ethan@arkadiahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion: adding 3 product teams + keys — draft MAP attached

Hi Ethan —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Based on the teams you mentioned (Clinical Insights, Claims Automation, and Customer Support AI), I've sketched a proposed mutual action plan and a key segmentation approach so each product team gets the correct rate limits and quotas.

Attached: Arkadia_MAP_v3.pdf — high level timeline and milestones. Key highlights:
- Phase 1 (June): Clinical Insights + 2 API keys, sandbox testing
- Phase 2 (July): Claims Automation on dedicated pool for peak batch jobs
- Phase 3 (Aug): Support AI pilot with streaming enabled

Two asks from your side to finalize pricing/SLA: expected QPS for Claims batch windows, and whether Support AI requires hard low-latency SLOs or soft targets.

If that plan looks good I can draft a short SLA amendment and route for signatures next week.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Arkadia_MAP_v3.pdf (120KB)]
From: Ethan Rosario <ethan@arkadiahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Langford <sophie.langford@arkadiahealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@arkadiahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: adding 3 product teams + keys — draft MAP attached

Ben —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. MAP looks good at a glance. Answers inline:
- Claims batch windows: expect 6–8 batch jobs nightly, peak parallelism ~60 QPS, but each job is bursty (10–15m windows).
- Support AI: we want sub-300ms 95th percentile for user-facing flows — so that would be a low-latency SLO.

A couple of procurement asks: can you split billing by project code? Also would like a draft SLA amendment to review.

Sophie (cc) will coordinate procurement.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Rosario
VP Product — Arkadia Health
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Rosario <ethan@arkadiahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@arkadiahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: adding 3 product teams + keys — draft MAP attached

Ethan —

Thanks for the details. I've updated the MAP to reflect bursty 60 QPS for Claims and a 300ms P95 SLO for Support AI. Attached is a lean SLA amendment (SLA_amendment_draft.docx) that:
- Adds a per-project billing code option (we can append invoice line items per project),
- Defines the P95 latency target and a credits table for breaches,
- Defines capacity buckets for our Dedicated pool for Claims batch windows.

I've also included a simple key segmentation CSV so your infra team can programmatically request keys with project codes.

Next steps I propose:
1) Sophie/Procurement confirms project codes and billing split
2) Redwood legal takes the minor SLA tweaks and issues a DocuSign next week
3) Technical kick-off — we schedule an onboarding session for the Clinical Insights team the week of June 7

I'm copying Marissa and Laura to make sure all operational pieces (capacity, onboarding) are blocked on our side.

Ben
[Attachments: SLA_amendment_draft.docx, key-segmentation-matrix.csv]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: internal: Arkadia expansion — capacity & pricing check

Ben / Laura —

Quick internal sync after reading Ethan's numbers:
- Claims batch: 60 QPS bursty across ~8 windows nightly — recommend reserving a Dedicated slot with 1.5x headroom (i.e., reserve capacity for 90 QPS during windows) to avoid throttles and keep latency predictable.
- Support AI: to meet 300ms P95 we'll want to pin them to the low-latency routing path (higher unit cost).

Pricing implications: propose we offer a blended committed rate that discounts tokens for Claims if they commit to reserved windows, and a small premium for Support AI low-latency SLA. Draft margin-preserving numbers in the attachment (internal).

Also: do we have any legal caveats around per-project invoicing? Laura — can you confirm?

-Marissa

[Internal note: keep SLA credits modest; prefer operational fallback (rate-limits) over heavy credits]
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: internal: Arkadia expansion — capacity & pricing check

Marissa —

Legal is fine with per-project invoicing as long as the master billing account remains Arkadia and we maintain one legal entity on contracts. I'll add standard language to the SLA amendment about billing split and invoices. No material blockers.

Ben — you can proceed to share the revised SLA with Arkadia procurement once we land the pricing. For the credits table, keep the cap at one monthly invoice credit — acceptable for enterprise deals.

-Laura
From: Sophie Langford <sophie.langford@arkadiahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@arkadiahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: adding 3 product teams + keys — draft MAP attached

Thanks team —

Procurement reviewed the SLA amendment and the billing split looks good. We're ready to proceed with the following:
- Confirmed project codes: CLIN-01, CLAIMS-02, SUPPORT-03
- We'll sign the SLA amendment in DocuSign after you update the credits cap language per Laura's note
- Please send the key-segmentation.csv formatted for our infra API so we can script key requests (see attached example).

Can we target the onboarding for Clinical Insights on June 8 (preferred) or June 10 (backup)?

If you send the final SLA and the CSV, procurement will push the DocuSign back to you for signature.

Sophie
Sophie Langford
Head of Procurement — Arkadia Health
[Attachment: key-segmentation-matrix.csv (3KB)]
